name: 鸿合投屏接收端
tagline: 鸿合设备专用投屏软件（接收端）
description: 鸿合投屏接收端是大屏端投屏软件的接收工具，为跨平台无线投屏解决方案，面向教育、会议、协作展示等场景。支持手机、平板、笔记本电脑等多种终端向安卓大屏（一体机）进行无线画面投射、反向控制、文件共享与多人协作。
descriptionEn: The receiver component of HiteVision's screen-sharing software, a cross-platform wireless casting solution for education, meetings and collaborative presentations. Phones, tablets and laptops can cast to an Android display (all-in-one panel), with reverse control, file sharing and multi-user collaboration.
notice: 请根据自己的系统下载对应客户端
noticeEn: Download the client that matches your system.
